text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of Narita Brian's debut race has 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian flashes a faint smile, 
thrilled at the prospect of competing 
against so many runners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping that this battle would entertain 
her, she headed into the race.
